name: Molvízar (Spain)
description: Divided by a blue bend from the upper hoist to the lower fly, yellow above and green below, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Molvízar (a tree and a sword on white above waves).
history: Municipal flag of Molvízar; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
